season.source: https://www.townoflisbonny.gov/beach-and-campground.html ('Our 2026 season is from May 1 to October 15'), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: https://www.townoflisbonny.gov/beach-and-campground.html ('We offer Full Hook Up (50 & 30 Amp), Water & Electric (50 & 30 amp), and Dry (tent) sites'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 'To reserve your spot, contact the Campground Office at 315-393-5374.' The town said in 2024 it would add an online reservation system; none is linked from its campground pages. Stays from one night to a whole season.

booking.source: https://www.townoflisbonny.gov/2024-camping-rates.html ('We will be implementing an online reservation system in 2024'; 'To reserve your spot, contact the Campground Office at 315-393-5374') + https://www.townoflisbonny.gov/beach-and-campground.html ('for camping anywhere from one night, to an entire season'), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://www.townoflisbonny.gov/2024-camping-rates.html ('have installed new wi-fi equipment for greatly improved internet access across the Lisbon recreation area'), read 2026-10-21

note: Town of Lisbon campground on the St. Lawrence River, 6 miles from the Ogdensburg-Prescott bridge. Lifeguarded public beach, boat launch; some riverfront sites. --Claude
summary: Town page confirms 2026 season May 1 - Oct 15 (new), 50 A full hookups and W/E (confirmed), reservations by phone to the campground office (online system promised in 2024 not linked), wifi; phone 315-393-5374 matches. Fees left as read 2026-10-11 (2024 sheet, still the linked one). Note trimmed: dropped the wrong 'Cheap ($22-28)' (rates are $29.76-36.38 resident) and the site/hookup/booking restatements. Site count (66) not stated on the pages; left derived.
